gluing.interpretation: A shared semantic kernel can be glued, but it does not erase local meanings.

transformation_tensor.interpretation: The 5×5 operator matrix is a base alphabet; actual meaning is indexed by observer, context, time, modality, scale and provenance.

meta_operator_proposals.name: obstruction-preserving-glue
meta_operator_proposals.purpose: Construct a shared model, audit its value/power effects, then return contested distinctions to the information graph instead of forcing consensus.
meta_operator_proposals.validation: The operator is accepted only if it improves predictive coordination without reducing recorded dissent or provenance.
meta_operator_proposals.rollback: Rollback when minority residual coverage falls or contradiction detection weakens.

meta_operator_proposals.name: residual-to-new-axis
meta_operator_proposals.purpose: Convert recurring untranslatable residuals into a candidate semantic dimension, design observations for it, and test whether it explains previously disconnected cases.
meta_operator_proposals.validation: Pre-register cases that the new axis must separate and cases on which it must remain neutral.
meta_operator_proposals.rollback: Delete or quarantine the axis if it merely renames an existing feature or amplifies one observer's language.

meta_operator_proposals.name: axis-seeding::concept-projection-loss
meta_operator_proposals.purpose: Operationalize the candidate dimension '概念投影损失' through measurements, models, and purpose revision.
meta_operator_proposals.validation: 把高维语义场压缩成一个词或定义时，哪些关系、尺度、冲突和可能性被系统性丢失？
meta_operator_proposals.rollback: Suspend if the dimension has low cross-observer transfer or cannot generate discriminating tests.

meta_operator_proposals.name: axis-seeding::scale-dependent-individuation
meta_operator_proposals.purpose: Operationalize the candidate dimension '尺度依赖个体化' through measurements, models, and purpose revision.
meta_operator_proposals.validation: 在细胞、个体、群体、生态或数字组织的不同尺度上，什么因果闭包使其成为可追踪的个体？
meta_operator_proposals.rollback: Suspend if the dimension has low cross-observer transfer or cannot generate discriminating tests.

meta_operator_proposals.name: axis-seeding::observer-participation
meta_operator_proposals.purpose: Operationalize the candidate dimension '观察者参与与反向塑形' through measurements, models, and purpose revision.
meta_operator_proposals.validation: 被评估对象是否会改变观察者的分类、测量和目的，使定义本身成为互动的一部分？
meta_operator_proposals.rollback: Suspend if the dimension has low cross-observer transfer or cannot generate discriminating tests.
